title.en: Substring with Concatenation of All Words

desc.zh: 把起点按除以 w 的余数分成 w 条扫描轨道。每条轨道 right 每次增加 w；left 是窗口左边界，图里的 right 是右端之后的字符下标。need 是所需次数，have 是当前次数，used 是词总数。
desc.en: Partition starts into w tracks by their remainder modulo w. Each track advances right by w. left is the window start; the displayed right is the exclusive end. need stores required counts, have current counts, and used the number of words.

complexity: O(Lw + kw) expected time; O(kw) auxiliary space plus output (L text characters, k words, w word width)

concepts.name: Word-aligned sliding window
concepts.description: Reuse word counts across aligned starts; shrink excess counts and scan every remainder.

concepts.name: Retained window and operation state
concepts.description: Compare before and after counts and exclusive window boundaries during add, shrink and reset.
